svg.title: GitHub contributions of Bisiaux-dev over the last year, drawn as constellations
svg.desc: One star per active day, laid out like the contribution graph: one column per week from the oldest on the left to today on the right, Sunday at the top. The more contributions a day has, the bigger and brighter its star; days without contributions are faint dust. Neighbouring days that touched the same repository are joined by thin lines, drawn one after another.
